world.h: Pope Leo urges Uruguayans to be 'bridge builders'
world.b: About 40,000 people attended the first Mass of his South American tour, which had been in doubt after his surgery.
world.title: Pope Leo hold first mass in Uruguay, urges crowd to be ‘bridge builders’

world.h: IRGC says weapons production moved underground
world.b: A spokesman said missile and drone lines were shifted to underground sites, with an 'underground missile city' set to be unveiled.

world.h: US sanctions eight Canadian exchange firms over Iran
world.b: The Treasury says the Ontario and British Columbia businesses helped Iran evade sanctions, some by converting currency into crypto.

world.h: Trump confirms new US strikes on Qeshm Island
world.b: 'We do minor strikes,' Trump said, after Iranian media reported two missile strikes on the Hormuz island and Iran said it downed a US drone.

world.h: Blasts heard in Iran's Qeshm and Bandar Abbas as US moves to block land routes
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Blasts heard in Iran’s Qeshm, Bandar Abbas as US moves to block land routes

national.h: Resident helps block $5 billion Maryland data center
national.b: Taylor Frazier McCollum joined opposition to a data center campus planned for the former Landover Mall site in Prince George's County.
national.title: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland

national.h: Democrats plan wider probes of fatal ICE shootings
national.b: In Minneapolis, residents have left 'I Voted' stickers at memorials for two US citizens killed by federal agents.
national.title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings

politics.h: Judge to probe whether officials misled her in golf course case
politics.b: She plans to appoint former US attorney Jessie Liu to examine conduct in the suit over the renovation of a public golf course on the Potomac.
politics.title: Judge wants former U.S. attorney to investigate whether the government misled her in Trump golf case

politics.h: Colom on cusp of Mississippi Senate history
politics.b: Ballots are still being counted in a race that could make him the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction.
politics.title: Scott Colom and Black Mississippians stand on the cusp of Senate history as vote count stretches on

politics.h: House Democrats plan fast start on health care and Iran war
politics.b: Leaders say early votes will target health care costs, ending the war with Iran and reversing some tariffs. 'We're going to get out of the gate fast,' Jeffries said.
politics.title: House Democrats will start their majority focused on boosting healthcare and ending the Iran war

politics.h: Trump says he asked Dana White to be press secretary
politics.b: Trump posted the offer to the UFC chief on social media. The White House did not respond to questions about it.
politics.title: Trump says he's asked UFC's Dana White to be his press secretary

politics.h: Texas vouchers could be 'unrecognizable' after Democratic wins
politics.b: Democrats won back the Texas House for the first time in 24 years, and some say Gov. Greg Abbott's voucher push turned off rural voters.
politics.title: Texas’ School Voucher Program Could Be “Unrecognizable, If Not Extinct,” Says Democratic Lawmaker

politics.h: Petition urges Democrats to pick a speaker other than Jeffries
politics.b: More than 980,000 people have signed, though Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become House speaker after the Democratic wave.

politics.h: Voters reject data centres in nearly every ballot measure
politics.b: Of 41 data centre measures on Tuesday's ballots, voters are on track to reject or limit development in all but one, a monitoring project says.

international.h: Canary Islands' El Hierro declares emergency over migrant arrivals
international.b: More than 3,300 people have reached the island of about 11,400 residents in roughly 30 boats since the start of November. Local leaders asked Madrid for help, and the Canary Islands' regional leader called the situation "absolutely unsustainable."
international.title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx

international.h: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
international.b: Santiago Pena was a shareholder in Ueno Bank, whose collapse has left millions without access to their money.
international.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors

international.h: More than 140,000 rally across France over costs
international.b: Unions put turnout at 250,000. Police clashed with some protesters in Paris and used tear gas.
international.title: More than 140,000 rally as new protests against rising costs sweep France

international.h: Israel's president taps Eisenkot to form government
international.b: Opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief, gets up to six weeks to build a coalition, a setback for Netanyahu.
international.title: Israel’s president taps opposition candidate Eisenkot to form a government, in setback for Netanyahu

international.h: Drone attacks drive villagers from Zaporizhzhia's south
international.b: Villages south of the regional capital face escalating Russian attacks, pushing residents into shelters for displaced people.

international.h: Rains flood displaced families' tents in Gaza
international.b: Civil defence crews got about 1,500 distress calls in 10 hours as water rose 30 to 40 cm in shelter sites.
international.title: Rains flood 70,000 displaced families’ tents in Gaza

international.h: Gunman kills six in Krakow's Main Square
international.b: Police say a 24-year-old opened fire on random people in the busy tourist square, wounding 15. He was shot and taken to hospital.

international.h: Haiti's prime minister hails killing of gang leader
international.b: Gang leader Saintil died after being shot in a police operation. 'One less gang leader,' Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime wrote.

international.h: Russian missiles hit Kyiv, injuring two
international.b: Debris struck an apartment building and a building housing a kindergarten was damaged, city officials said.

international.h: New Zealand election too close to call
international.b: Early counts show the two main parties neck and neck, with neither likely to win a majority. Final results are due Nov. 27.

science.h: Strokes are rising among younger adults
science.b: Stroke incidence among adults 20 to 54 nearly doubled from 1993-94 to 2020, even as rates fell for older people.
science.title: Sen. Chris Murphy’s stroke at 53 highlights a trend: Strokes among younger adults have risen

science.h: Promising heart drug fails major study
science.b: The medicine lowered a blood particle linked to heart attacks and strokes but did not protect volunteers. 'I was shocked,' the lead researcher said.
science.title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly

science.h: Pakistani astronaut to join China's space station
science.b: China says a Pakistani astronaut will fly on its next station mission, expected by year's end.

sports.h: Oregon stuns Ohio State in college football's Week 10
sports.b: No. 23 Oregon won at Ohio State, and No. 3 Utah beat No. 9 BYU in the Holy War rivalry. Ohio State and LSU moved outside the playoff bubble.
sports.title: College football winners, losers: Texas charging down backstretch; is Nebraska cursed?

sports.b: LSU led 13-10 in the third quarter before Alabama scored 21 unanswered points, handing Lane Kiffin his sixth straight loss to the Crimson Tide. LSU falls to 6-3.
sports.title: Lane Kiffin falls flat against Alabama as massive LSU hype crashes into reality

sports.h: Man arrested for stalking outside LeBron James' LA home
sports.b: James, now with the 76ers, was in Cleveland when the incident happened.

sports.h: Colts listening to offers for Daniel Jones
sports.b: Multiple teams have called about the quarterback ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline, ESPN reports.

sports.h: Nebraska fires offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen
sports.b: Matt Rhule made the change after a 24-13 loss to Illinois dropped the Huskers to 5-4 following a 5-0 start.

sports.h: Winless Chargers to keep Khalil Mack at deadline
sports.b: The 0-7 Chargers reportedly told teams Mack stays, and gave 'hard nos' on Justin Herbert and Ladd McConkey ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

sports.h: Luka Doncic's historic start for the Lakers
sports.b: Doncic has the Lakers atop the West at 8-2, with games of 52 and 53 points so far.
sports.title: The numbers behind Luka Dončić's historic start are entering the realm of ridiculous

sports.h: Texas Tech's Okechukwu is tallest in women's college hoops
sports.b: The 7-foot-1 center from Nigeria had 6 points, 10 rebounds and 3 blocks in her debut, the first 7-footer to play NCAA women's basketball.

goodnews.h: What Diwali is and how it is celebrated
goodnews.b: More than a billion people mark the Festival of Lights, which falls on Nov. 8 this year. Celebrants place rows of clay oil lamps outside their homes to symbolize the victory of light over darkness.
goodnews.title: What is Diwali, the Festival of Lights, and how is it celebrated?

goodnews.h: New LSU scholarships for former foster youth
goodnews.b: Melania Trump and LSU raised more than $7 million in private donations for an endowment funding scholarships for students who were in foster care.
goodnews.title: Melania Trump and LSU announce a scholarship program for students who were in foster care

goodnews.h: Teen fighting period stigma wins Diana Award
goodnews.b: Aadvik Jain of Delhi, who began campaigning at 14, is among 198 young changemakers from 44 countries honored this year.
goodnews.title: This teen boy set out to get people talking about periods. He's now a Diana honoree

local.h: Judge orders NYC to give ICE names of Bronx shelter residents
local.b: Judge Lewis Kaplan ruled the city must comply with the subpoena. City Hall, which bars agencies from cooperating with ICE, had fought it.
local.title: Federal judge rules Mamdani administration must give ICE names of Bronx shelter residents

local.h: Work begins to replace Newark Bay Bridge
local.b: The 1956 span carries about 95,000 vehicles a day. The new bridge is due in 2031 and the old one stays open meanwhile.
local.title: Work is underway to replace deteriorating Newark Bay Bridge, a major NY-NJ route

local.h: Schools employee charged in Brooklyn jogger's murder
local.b: Police charged Sayed Mohassib, 27, in the Oct. 30 stabbing of Katie Suarez on the Shore Parkway path. He has been suspended.
local.title: NYPD arrests and charges city schools employee in murder of Brooklyn jogger

local.title: Quest Diagnostics pays $13M to settle kickback allegations involving NY Giants tickets
